offence_note: Marihuana production and possession, firearms offences, illegal cigarettes
sentence_quote: leave to appeal sentence is granted, the sentence imposed by the trial judge is varied and a sentence of time served is substituted.
note: Global sentence three months equals time served; excise fines and ancillary orders not appealed, amounts not shown.

offence_note: Second degree murder with a handgun
sentence_quote: The period of parole ineligibility is then set at 13 years. The ancillary orders for DNA and a lifetime weapons prohibition will be granted.
systemic_quote: His decision to remain in Mulgrave Park, to get a gun rather than to call the police and to seek out the confrontation with Ryan White make no sense at all unless they are considered in light of his background.
note: African Nova Scotian and Mi'kmaq; court endorsed warrant to serve in Ontario and culturally appropriate counselling.

offence_note: Criminal negligence causing death and bodily harm by driving; dangerous driving
sentence_quote: The trial judge sentenced the appellant to a global period of imprisonment of 6 years and imposed driving prohibition orders of 10 years on each count of criminal negligence causing death and 7 years on the count of criminal negligence causing bodily harm, along with a DNA order
note: Majority set aside the driving prohibitions as unlawful; six-year term stood; dissent ignored.

sentence_quote: The global sentence I impose for your crimes is 12 years of imprisonment.
note: SOIRA and weapons prohibition for life; Kienapple conditional stays on counts 14 and 15.

offence_note: Robbery as driver of getaway car
sentence_quote: I would grant leave to appeal, allow the appeal, and suspend the passing of sentence and impose a probationary term for the maximum of three years.
note: Two years less a day jail replaced by suspended sentence; counselling required; s. 100 prohibition confirmed.

offence_note: Possession of MDMA for the purpose of trafficking
sentence_quote: we are of the view that the sentence of four years imprisonment was neither harsh nor excessive.

offence_note: Offences not shown; conviction after police chase and identification
sentence_quote: we allow the sentence appeal to the extent of increasing credit for pre-trial custody to four years, six months (two years, three months x 2), resulting in a net sentence of three years, nine months.
note: Offences not stated; credit increased from 1.5:1 to 2:1.

note: Conditional sentences of two years less a day replaced; one-to-one credit for time on conditional sentence, amount not stated.
